capabilities: Export archived Codex sessions to Markdown notes
Group exported notes by session workdir or project name
Add frontmatter with session id, project, cwd, source path, and tags
Extract base64-encoded images into a media folder
Skip already-exported sessions unless overwrite is enabled
extras: Desktop-only; uses Node.js filesystem access to read files outside the vault, with output paths constrained to the current vault.
problem: Codex Desktop/CLI stores session histories as JSONL files outside the vault, making them hard to read, search, or link from Obsidian notes.
summary: Imports local Codex session JSONL logs into the vault as Markdown notes grouped by workspace, with frontmatter and extracted base64 images.
